thread:
nathan: FYI we've published a small handbook update to the "Hybrid & Remote Work Stipend" page and rolled out a required 5-minute acknowledgment for all employees who receive the stipend. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/remote-stipend 

nathan: The update clarifies eligible expenses, quarterly reconciliation expectations, and the new yearly cap for tiered roles. Acknowledgment is a quick checkbox + one short question. Please complete by next Friday. :laptop:

isabel: Quick Q: does this apply to new hires who join after the deadline but receive a prorated stipend?

nathan: New hires who join after the deadline will receive the acknowledgment as part of onboarding; the tracker will record those separately. Managers: expect a small onboarding reminder for any new hire stipend grants.

hazel: For hiring managers: will stipend approvals still go through Finance or is it now manager-approved in Workday?

nathan: Approvals remain in Workday. We added a short note in the handbook about manager sign-off for exceptions above the standard tier. Finance still has final approval for overage requests.

tony: Contractors question: long-term contractors with company laptops but not on payroll  are they eligible for stipend and the acknowledgment?

nathan: Contractors on payroll or on a contract that explicitly includes a stipend are eligible and will be assigned the acknowledgment. 1099s not in the stipend program are excluded. If you think a contractor should be added, DM people-ops and we'll review.

sam: Will there be a CSV export for reconciliation? I need to match with expense reports.

nathan: Yes  we'll provide a CSV export with `employee_email, manager_email, stipend_tier, acknowledged_at, last_reconciled_at, exemption_note`. Managers can export their team's rows; Finance gets the full org export.

isabel: Any exemptions if someone already completed external vendor compliance about equipment purchases last month?

nathan: Not applicable in this case  the stipend acknowledgment is about policy and reconciliation, not vendor training. If there are edge cases, email people-ops@redwood.com and we'll add notes in the tracker.

hr-bot: Automated assignment: 143 employees assigned to "Remote Work Stipend 5min acknowledgment". Due: 2025-10-10. Tracker URL: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-09-28 11:00 UTC) :bell:

hazel: Reminders cadence and late policy?

nathan: We'll send reminders at 7 days and 48 hours. Missed > 10 days = manager follow-up and a flagged note in People Ops dashboard. No disciplinary action for a late acknowledgment; repeated misses will be escalated to the HRBP.

tony: For the CSV can you also include a `stipend_approved_by` column? helpful for Finance audits.

nathan: Good call  adding `stipend_approved_by` and `workday_request_id` to the export. Example header: `employee_email,manager_email,stipend_tier,acknowledged_at,last_reconciled_at,stipend_approved_by,workday_request_id,exemption_note`.

sam: Will the handbook have a changelog blurb so I can include it in the finance weekly update?

nathan: Yes  changelog at bottom of the handbook page. Suggested blurb: "Updated Hybrid & Remote Work Stipend policy: clarified eligible expenses, reconciliation cadence, and tiered caps. 5-min acknowledgment required; deadline 2025-10-10." Feel free to shorten for the update.

isabel: Thanks  I'll ping people-ops if my hires need temporary accounts for the tracker.

hazel: I'll pull the CSV after Monday's snapshot to reconcile with Q3 expense reports.

nathan: Great  I'll drop the CSV to #people-ops-finance and #managers once snapshot is ready. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
